comment: Authored stimulus descriptors. headline/body are what Phase-2 perception reads; 'claims' here are the pre-authored ground truth used to seed fixtures and as golden perception targets (perception output must map onto these Concept ids or OTHER). claimed_pct feeds offer_attractiveness (perceived deal) — distinct from the realized price gap.

creatives.name: Planet-First Run
creatives.headline: Run lighter on the planet.
creatives.body: The EcoStride Runner is built from 90% recycled ocean plastic. Every stride gives back.

creatives.name: Cloud Comfort
creatives.headline: Like walking on clouds. All day.
creatives.body: CloudLoft Daily: plush comfort that goes with everything, and straight into the washing machine.
creatives.note: ShoeCo concept-rotation arm for F12 (different story, same brand)

creatives.name: EcoStride Sale
creatives.headline: The planet-friendly runner. Now 15% off.
creatives.body: Featherlight, earth-first, and on sale this week only. The EcoStride Runner.
creatives.note: The Appendix-B stimulus: same eco story as 2000001 (fatigue driver); its DISCOUNT claim (5011) is what page 4000002 hides (expectation_violation).

creatives.name: Apex Performance
creatives.headline: Built for the podium.
creatives.body: The Apex Racer: race-tuned cushioning and support trusted by champions. 10% off for race season.

creatives.name: Everyday Value
creatives.headline: Great shoes. Honest prices.
creatives.body: Flex Street by UrbanStride: everyday style that doesn't empty your wallet.
